$comment: ONE source for the /qf critic's reply shape (docs/QF_ARC.md WP-3). tools/qf/ledger.py validates replies against `schema`; tools/workflows/qf_root_loop.js (local-only, gitignored) carries a generated copy of `schema` between CRITIC_SCHEMA markers, kept equal by tools/qf/schema_sync.py --check. `statuses` is the per-question ledger vocabulary; `stops` is the one stop list. Edit here, then run schema_sync.py --write.

proofOfRead.description: PROOF you actually opened the discipline files (not run on the prompt alone). Each fragment is a VERBATIM <=12-word run of an actual rule from that file; the main session verifies them mechanically (tools/qf/verify_proof.py) - a fabricated or non-matching fragment discards the reply.

qfDoc.description: verbatim <=12-word fragment of a rule from docs/QUESTION_FORM_AGENT.md

opusDoc.description: verbatim <=12-word fragment of a rule from docs/OPUS_48_DISCIPLINE.md

priorArt.description: lessons-ledger rows you opened yourself, each with a verbatim <=10-word fragment; must include at least one row NOT listed in the brief's PRIOR ART section once that section exists (QF_ARC WP-2)

identity.description: the row's identity as printed by tools/qf/prior_art.py: section / first 60 chars of its title

credit.description: one line naming what is now GENUINELY measured

unresolved.description: 2-4 questions. Every entry is a QUESTION; the other fields are citations and probe names, never statements, plans or fixes - any field carrying an instruction or a fix voids the reply.

angle.description: the ONE named angle this question comes from (closed list; the ledger rejects anything else)

targetClaim.description: a VERBATIM quote of the brief sentence under attack (a citation, not a paraphrase)

howToMeasure.description: a concrete READ-ONLY probe that would settle it - a real log grep, bytecode disasm, code read, or IDA site - WITH its command; an imperative that changes anything is a fix and voids the reply

runtimeGated.description: true if this question can ONLY be settled by a runtime probe (an instrumented rebuild, a fresh single-variable run) and NO read-only grep/disasm/IDA read can settle it

anchor.description: what YOU opened this round to ask this: 'path:line' in the tree; or for an OMISSION the symbol + the file/tree the brief says owns it + the zero-hit command ('grep -c ... = 0'); or for an ask/product angle the targetClaim quote itself. At least one question per round must carry a path:line or a command; in a DIFF pass every question must.

converged.description: true ONLY when no material claim remains INFERRED rather than measured (the fact base is SETTLED)

readOnlyFloor.description: true when EVERY remaining unresolved question is runtimeGated - all read-only measurement is exhausted and the remainder needs a rebuild. A SUCCESSFUL terminal state, distinct from converged.

anchor.description: REQUIRED when converged or readOnlyFloor is true: the last lookup you made that found nothing left to ask (command + result). A verdict with nothing opened is discarded.

convergenceRationale.description: only with converged or readOnlyFloor: one entry per closed question, '<id>: closed by <citation>' - no prose
